scenes.en: Eye infections rise in the monsoon.
scenes.say: It was raining in Chennai, and Selvi's son Hari came home rubbing his eyes.

scenes.en: Dirty rainwater, damp hands and crowds help eye germs spread.
scenes.ta: மழைநீர், ஈரமான கைகள் மூலம் கிருமிகள் பரவும்
scenes.say: In the monsoon, dirty rainwater, damp hands and crowded places help eye germs spread fast. That's why eye infections go up.

scenes.en: Soap and water, before touching the eyes
scenes.ta: கண்ணைத் தொடும் முன் சோப்பால் கை கழுவுங்கள்
scenes.say: So Selvi made him wash his hands with soap and water first. Clean hands before touching the eyes.

scenes.en: Never share towels, pillows or handkerchiefs.
scenes.say: Step two. Everyone uses their own towel. Never share towels, pillows or handkerchiefs.

scenes.en: Splashed? Rinse with clean water only.
scenes.say: Step three. Keep rainwater out of your eyes. If it splashes in, rinse with clean water only.

scenes.en: Eye flu spreads mostly through hands and shared things.
scenes.ta: கண் தொற்று கைகள் வழியாக எளிதில் பரவும்
scenes.say: Did you know? Eye flu spreads mostly through hands and shared things. Just looking at someone won't give it to you.

scenes.en: Pain, light sensitivity, blurred vision, or no better in a few days
scenes.ta: வலி, மங்கலான பார்வை இருந்தால் மருத்துவரை பாருங்கள்
scenes.say: See an eye specialist if there's pain, light sensitivity, blurred vision, or if it's not better in a few days.

scenes.en: Book an eye test for the family.
scenes.say: Stay safe this monsoon. Book an eye test for the whole family.
